question: Is Luffy's pose on the cover of Volume 3 from Ken Shimura-san's "Aiiin"?
answer: Oh my god, you're right!! It's Aiiin!! It really is. Yes, it is Aiiin. ("Aiiin" is a well-known gag from veteran comedian Shimura Ken. Ken's recent famous characters are Baka Tono (Stupid Lord) and Henna Ojisan. Baka Tono's signature pose is "Aiiiiiiin!" The sub-unit of Morning Musume, Mini Moni even did an entire song on it called "Ai~n! Dance Song")
name: Ken
